tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs bzhugs/

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa byed lugs mdor bsdus pa ni/ phyi mtshams bcad/ de'i nub sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ de'i nub nas sam sang tho rangs nas gzung zhag bdun gyi bar la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang khyad par rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la gtso bor bya/ thun 'jog khar/ mgon po bdag ni/ zhes pa nas/ byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ sogs brjod/ de nas nang mtshams bcad/ tho brtsigs yang na bug sgo bya/ mar ram mar dang bsres pa'i zan la gtor ma gnyis sam gcig bshams/ chang chu nang mchod kyis sbyangs/ rang kha blta sar gtor ma dang mchod bshams yong ba byas/ rnal 'byor ma'i sku zhig yod na mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ med kyang bla ma yi dam kyi sku gzugs gang rung la mchod pa rgyas pa'am/ ma grub na nyer spyod lnga g.yon skor lag len ltar dang*/ nyin re bzhin mchod pa gtor ma kha gsos/ mtshams nang du dgos nges kyi mi yod na dmigs 'og tu bcug /de phyin don ji ltar gal che yang mi 'phrad/ chas ka sngar yod phyir mi gtong zhing*/ gsar pa rang nyid yod sar mi len/ skabs 'di dag tu skyid sdug legs nyes/ gtam snyan mi snyan sogs gang la'ang re dogs med pa dang*/ rgyun du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ khyad par sngags 'phreng bskor re song nas rang lhar mos pa slar gsal 'debs pa re dang*/ bla ma la mos gus dung pa dang*/ /sems la snying rje dung pa re nges par dran par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa 'di ma grol bar la rkyen gang gi yang dbang du mi btang*/ na na yang na go chod/ shi na yang shi go chod/ sngar mi lus thob pa phal cher don med du song ba la/ da lta yi dam kyi lha 'di lta bu sgrub tu yod pa skal pa bzang*/ 'bad rtsol drag po zhig bya snyam pa'i zhe bcad chen po bya/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/

rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zhes pa nas/ sum bha lan gnyis brjod pa'i bar bya/ nang mchod byin rlabs ni/ sum bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung nas/ ha hoḥhrī'i bar bya/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni sum bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang lha rdzas zhes pa nas/ a khaṃ swāhā'i bar bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams yun thung ngu re dang*/ de rjes bskyed rim la rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du zhes pa nas 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim gyi bar bya/ de nas rang gi lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po/ de'i mdun nas g.yon skor du oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i yi ge mgo bo gyen bstan dang*/ kha dog dmar por bsam/ sngags bzla skabs lte ba'i sngags 'khor la sems brtad dal bu bzla/ thun 'jog khar yid bzlas bya/ nyin gcig la thun gnyis byed na/ snga thun 'jog khar/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum zhes pa nas slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ mchod bstod cung zad byas kyang rung*/ ma byas kyang rung ngo*/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag mkha' spyod dag pa nas/ go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i nas/ thugs ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul tu rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar bya/ de nas ngag 'grol ba dang zas kyi bya ba sogs bya/ dgong thun la skyabs 'gros brtsams te/ gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i rjes su gtor bsngo bya/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i nas/

cho 'phrul rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar bya/ yi ge brgya pa'i rjes su/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sho lo ka gcig /bdag gis dus gsum sogs smon lam dang bkra shis bya/ nyal ba'i tshe lha sku mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bsdus la/ bsam med kyi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dang*/ nye ba'i snying po'i sgras bskul bas/ 'od gsal las ldang ste/ skad cig gi rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsams nas thun la 'jug go / thun gyi skabs ngag ma shor bar gal che'o/ /re zhig de tsam mo/ /zhus dag /maṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs bzhugs/ - PAGE 90 -- PAGE 91 -- PAGE 89 -
